tiers.name: site-content
tiers.holds: The band's content, carried over unchanged from the Jekyll site: src/content/data/*.json (site, navigation, albums, bio, photos, videos, friends, shows), src/content/posts/*.md (the news posts, front matter + markdown), and public/assets/images/. Data, not code.

tiers.name: site-lib
tiers.holds: The site's non-UI layer: typed access to the content (content.ts, posts.ts), the Liquid-compatible date and excerpt filters (dates.ts, excerpt.ts), the kramdown-compatible markdown renderer (markdown.ts), SEO metadata and JSON-LD (seo.ts), and style.css, the Jekyll stylesheet verbatim.

tiers.name: site-components
tiers.holds: The site's React components: header, footer, hero/page shell, post and show cards, link lists and icons, the member grid and the photo lightbox.

tiers.name: site-app
tiers.holds: The Next app: App Router routes under src/app/ (one per Jekyll page, the post and member pages, sitemap and robots) and the app's config (package.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, vercel.json).

tiers.name: website-workspace
tiers.holds: The pnpm workspace root config (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, the lockfile) and build helpers under websites/tools/ (fetch_submodules.py, which Vercel's install step runs). Config, not library code.

tiers.name: external-submodules
tiers.holds: Git submodule checkouts (agenticdevelopertoolkit, whatsnowtoolkit — see shared_packages). Deliberately outside the pnpm workspace glob since each submodule is its own workspace. Vendored; not edited here.

tiers.name: repo-tools
tiers.holds: Repo-level operator scripts run by hand, not by any build: provision-vercel.py, which creates and reconciles the three scratchyfish-* Vercel projects.

tiers.name: repo-meta
tiers.holds: Claude Code project config, the shipr deploy config, the sites CLI's local suite config, and repo housekeeping. No code.
